attribution: Event information from the Hawaiʻi State Foundation on Culture and the Arts (SFCA) monthly Arts & Culture Calendar.

events.title: “Creative Micronesia” at Capitol Modern: the Hawaiʻi State Art Museum
events.description: Events and mini-exhibit featuring Micronesian and Pacific Islands artists, activities, and performances. Learn more on the SFCA website: sfca.hawaii.gov/creative-micronesia-at-state-art-museum-exhibit-family-friendly-events-through-august-2026 .

events.title: E Heluhelu Kākou: Swimming into Stories community event
events.description: at Windward Community College (Kāneʻohe, Oʻahu). Saturday, August 1, 10:00 a.m. – noon. Storytelling, crafts, and hands-on ocean fun for kids ages 2-19. All ages welcome. For more information, please visit the Hale Laʻakea website: library.wcc.hawaii.edu/events/upcoming#s-lg-box-wrapper-41680612 .

events.title: Hotel Street Art Hui mural painting and live music
events.description: Friday August 7, 4:00 – 6:00 p.m. at 29 N. Hotel Street (Honolulu Chinatown). Free, all ages welcome.

events.title: Mizu Wai / Story Weaving East Maui Waterways community story weaving
events.description: project on Saturday August 8, 9:00 a.m. – 4:00 p.m. at Keʻanae Peninsula Ballpark (Maui). Learn more on the Nest Maker Space website: NestMakerspace.weebly.com/mizu-wai.html .

events.title: Drawn to Music: A  Collaborative Live Music and Art Event
events.description: Drawn to Music: A Collaborative Live Music and Art Event on Saturday, August 8 at Dr. Sun Yat-Sen Park (Chinatown, Honolulu), 1:00 – 4:00 p.m. For more information, visit the Guitar Foundation of Hawaiʻi website: GuitarFoundationHawaii.org .

events.title: Welcome Home Kōlea Festival at Ala Moana Beach Park
events.description: (Honolulu) Saturday, September 19, 2026, 10:00 a.m. – 2:00 p.m. Event includes display of kōlea artwork. Learn more on the Hawaiʻi Audubon Society website: HiAudubon.org/events/welcome-home-kolea-2026 .

events.title: Summer Flix free movie screening
events.description: at the Prince Waikiki hotel. Wednesday 7:00 p.m. August 5, 2026. Get more information on the Hawaiʻi International Film Festival website: hiff.org/summer-flix .

events.title: Honolulu Museum of Art HoMA Nights
events.description: every Friday until 9:00 p.m. Live music and experiences, included with admission. For more information, please visit the Honolulu Museum of Art website: HonoluluMuseum.org/events .

events.title: ʻIolani Palace Kamaʻāina Sundays
events.description: monthly event with free presentations and acitivities. For more information, please visit the ʻIolani Palace website: IolaniPalace.org/visit/kamaaina-Sundays .

events.title: Bishop Museum After Hours
events.description: monthly event, 5:00 – 9:00 p.m. on the second Friday of each month, exploring Hawaiʻi’s cultural and natural history. For more information, please visit the Bishop Museum website: BishopMuseum.org/exhibits-and-programs/afterhours .

events.title: Hawaiʻi State Public Libraries
events.description: offer free events including keiki storytime, crafting, games, and workshops. Explore the Hawaiʻi State Public Library System events: LibrariesHawaii.org/events .

events.title: First Friday at Capitol Modern: the Hawaiʻi State Art Museum
events.description: : free, all-ages of evening of art and music at Capitol Modern: the Hawaiʻi State Art Museum every first Friday of the month, 5:00 – 9:00 p.m. First Fridays in Honolulu calendar: FirstFridayHawaii.com .

events.title: Super Saturday at Capitol Modern: the Hawaiʻi State Art Museum
events.description: August 15, 11:00 a.m. – 3:00 p.m. Hands-on art making for all ages. The August Super Saturday features Micronesian and other Pacific Islander performances and activities.

events.title: Drawn to Music: A  Collaborative Live Music and Art Event
events.description: Drawn to Music: A Collaborative Live Music and Art Event on Saturday, August 8 at Dr. Sun Yat-Sen Park (Chinatown, Honolulu), 1:00 – 4:00 p.m. For more information, visit the Guitar Foundation of Hawaiʻi website: GuitarFoundationHawaii.org .

events.title: Diamond Head Theatre presents “Les Misérables”
events.description: July 30 – August 16, 2026. More information on their website: DiamondHeadTheatre.com/shows-tickets .

events.title: Hawaiʻi Public Radio “Hawaiʻi Radio Hour” broadcasting from Kahilu Theatre
events.description: Sundays at 4:00 p.m. on HPR-1. Conversations, moʻolelo, and mele. Learn more and listen on the Kahilu website: kahilu.org/hawaii-radio-hour-episodes .

events.title: ʻIolani Palace Royal Hawaiian Band Performances
events.description: on most Fridays, 12:00 – 1:00 p.m. Free outdoor concert, open to the public. Learn more on the ʻIolani Palace website: IolaniPalace.org/events/royal-hawaiian-band-concerts .

events.title: West Hawaiʻi County Band monthly concert
events.description: at Hale Hālāwai County Park on Aliʻi Drive (Kailua-Kona, Hawaiʻi Island). Learn more about their monthly concerts on their website: WestHawaiiBand.com/schedule .

events.title: “Interwoven Views: threads of influence” exhibit of artworks by State of Hawaiʻi Department of Education art instructors
events.description: At Capitol Modern: the Hawaiʻi State Art Museum through August 26. On the ground floor in the cafe area. Learn more on the SFCA website: sfca.hawaii.gov/doe-art-teachers-exhibit-work-from-their-personal-art-practices-in-state-art-museum-through-august-26 .

events.title: “Portal 3” at the Firehouse Gallery, Waimea Arts Council
events.description: (Hawaiʻi Island). August 1 – September 27, 2026. Learn more on the Waimea Arts Council website: FirehouseArtGallery.org/category/in-the-firehouse-gallery . An SFCA Art Acquisition Selection Committee has visited this exhibit.

events.title: “LUMINOSITY: The Legacy” at Viewpoints Gallery Maui
events.description: August 2 – October 31, 2026. An SFCA Art Acquisition Selection Committee has visited this exhibit.

events.title: “Hawaiʻi’s Woodshow: Na Laʻau O Hawaiʻi”
events.description: August 7 – August 29, 2026 at the Downtown Art Center. Learn more on the Downtown Art Center website: DowntownArtHI.org/exhibitions . The SFCA Board of Commissioners has approved an Art Acquisition Selection Committee visit to this exhibit.

events.title: “16th Annual Abstract Only!” at Wailoa Center
events.description: (Hawaiʻi Island), August 14 – September 17, 2026. Learn more on the Wailoa Center website: WailoaCenter.com/exhibitions-1 . The SFCA Board of Commissioners has approved an Art Acquisition Selection Committee visit to this exhibit.

events.title: “ʻAimama” at Gallery ʻIolani, Windward Community College
events.description: August 27 – December 10, 2026. For more information, please visit the Gallery ʻIolani website: gallery.windward.hawaii.edu . The SFCA Board of Commissioners has approved an Art Acquisition Selection Committee visit to this exhibit.

events.title: “Trifecta”
events.description: exhibit at Capitol Modern: the Hawaiʻi State Art Museum featuring artworks from the state collection, curated by members of the local arts community. Learn more on the Capitol Modern website: CapitolModern.org/exhibits/trifecta .

events.title: “Peace by Piece” quilt show
events.description: at Volcano Art Center (Hawaiʻi Island), July 19 – August 11, 2026. Textile and Fabric Pop-Up July 25 and 26; Needlebook workshop August 2. Learn more on the Volcano Art Center website: VolcanoArtCenter.org .

events.title: “2026 Pacific States Biennial North American” printmaking exhibition
events.description: at the University of Hawaiʻi Hilo (Hawaiʻi Island) November 2, 2026 – January 14, 2027.

events.title: “Ea Mai ʻEiwa: Patterns of Practice” at the Bernice Pauahi Bishop Museum
events.description: through September 20, 2026. Learn more on the museum website: BishopMuseum.org/Eiwa .

events.title: “AHA! Art Immersive” exhibit
events.description: July 3 – August 6, 2026 at Wailoa Center (Hilo, Hawaiʻi Island). More information on the Wailoa Center website: WailoaCenter.com/exhibitions-1 . An SFCA Art Acquisition Selection Committee has visited this exhibit.

events.title: University of Hawaiʻi Insect Museum art show
events.description: at Honolulu Printmakers, opening reception October 24, 2026. More information to come on the UH Insect Museum website: ctahr.hawaii.edu/insectmuseum .
